description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, with 12 slices in total. The categories and their corresponding approximate percentages are: AI/NLP Research (24.3%, blue), Econ. & Fin. (18.4%, teal), Game&Anime (8.2%, yellow), History (8.2%, brown), Daily Life (7.1%, gray), Med & Health and Science (both 6.7%, olive green and blue-gray respectively), Business (5.9%, red), Pet & Animal (5.5%, orange), Law (5.1%, maroon), Geography (2.7%, green), and Math (1.2%, light green). The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, connected to their respective categories by lines, and the slices are distinguishable by their colors. The slices are not ordered in a particular way, and two categories, AI/NLP Research and Econ. & Fin., are notably larger than the others.
